post.summary: Preview with `commit=false` (default); write with `commit=true`. Only valid rows are written.

parameters.name: AfterId
parameters.description: Seek paging: return rows older than this ledger id. Use it instead of `Page` for deep pages (constant cost at any depth).

parameters.name: IncludeTotal
parameters.description: False skips the row count, which is the expensive part of a very large ledger.

get.summary: Barcode or SKU lookup for the line picker and scanning. 404 when nothing matches.

allowedActions.description: What the caller may do right now (edit, submit, approve, reject, cancel, post, reverse). The UI shows buttons from this list only.

total.description: Rows matching the filter, or int Paging.TotalNotCounted when the caller asked to skip the (expensive) count.

nextCursor.description: Id to pass as `afterId` for the next page of a seek-paged list; null when there is no further page or the list is not seek-paged.
